name: Upright blue beardtongue
desc: Upright blue beardtongue (Penstemon virgatus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Penstemon virgatus, the wandbloom penstemon, is a species of flowering plant from western North America. It grows as far south as southwestern Mexico and as far north as southern Wyoming.
